title: backup target clear treats an uninspectable records directory as no target configured
outcome: backup target clear treats an uninspectable records directory as no target configured
acceptance: clear_target distinguishes a missing records directory from one whose metadata cannot be read (try_exists or metadata), refusing the latter with a path-bearing error instead of reporting that no target was configured; a test in the repository covers the error branch
disposal_reason: Fixed by the landing of w-76e601495068 (commit caaafac). clear_target no longer checks the directory with Path::exists. It reads both records first; only a file that is NotFound counts as absent, and any other read error is backup_record_unreadable. A test puts a directory in place of each record. The regression test for an uninspectable ancestor is tracked separately in w-e57434c7e119.
